capabilities: Insert kaomoji and emoji via :shortcode autocomplete
Add, edit and remove shortcode entries in settings
Import shortcode pairs from JSON and export the set to clipboard
extras: Desktop only; not available on Obsidian for iOS or Android. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to insert kaomoji or custom text emoji through a shortcode autocomplete while typing.
summary: Kaomoji plugin that inserts kaomoji, unicode emoji and text snippets via a :shortcode autocomplete popup.
